comparison.objective: Place scaffold boards across two bays with specified overlap and end projection; candidate finishes threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-board transport, support and geometric placement versus small-tool alignment, impact regulation and millimetre-scale fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Boards lap over the middle putlog and project 19–38 mm at ends; candidate requires four fractures and contained tangs without component displacement.
comparison.reason: The scale, mechanism and tested outcome are materially different; shared placement primitives are generic.
